evidence_policy: Only reproduced, measured, target, and architecture claims below may be used publicly with their stated scope.

data_scope.provenance: independently generated synthetic data; no external or confidential dataset
data_scope.license: MIT repository code; generated rows are not redistributed

champion.policy: classifier OR VAE OR sigma guardrails OR lot drift block

claims.claim: The versioned benchmark contains 58,000 independently generated synthetic chips across eight isolated chronological/grouped splits, plus a disjoint 10,000-chip post-freeze operational-envelope confirmation.
claims.allowed_wording: 68,000 independently generated synthetic chips across isolated development, confirmation, robustness, and post-freeze splits.

claims.claim: The selected hybrid was chosen from 180 eligible hybrid OR policies within a 198-candidate catalog by maximizing validation time reduction subject to every predeclared safety gate; confirmation data was not used for selection.
claims.allowed_wording: Selected the highest-reduction eligible hybrid policy from 180 candidates under predeclared escape, uncertainty, and over-test gates.

claims.claim: Classifier-only, VAE-only, and sigma-only ablations were measured but were ineligible for promotion and failed at least one safety gate; the hybrid traded some simulated reduction for bounded escape risk.
claims.allowed_wording: Component ablations saved more simulated time but failed safety gates; the selected hybrid reduced escape risk.

claims.claim: The first frozen known-mode confirmation was rejected because the drift guard blocked all 20 lots, yielding zero escapes but 100% over-test and 0% simulated reduction.
claims.allowed_wording: Retained a rejected first frozen confirmation that failed utility because all lots were blocked.

claims.claim: On the 5,000-chip synthetic OOD confirmation, all ten shifted lots were blocked and all chips ran the optional test, producing zero escapes and 0% simulated reduction.
claims.allowed_wording: The synthetic OOD guard failed closed by running every chip; this demonstrates blocking, not OOD per-chip classification.

claims.claim: On 10,000 new chronological synthetic chips inside the declared development envelope, the exact frozen bundle measured 13.524% simulated time reduction, 99.0% defect recall, six escapes among 600 failures, and 4.149% over-test.
claims.allowed_wording: Measured 13.524% simulated optional-stage reduction at 99.0% defect recall, with 6/600 escaped synthetic failures and 4.149% over-test on a disjoint 10,000-chip post-freeze confirmation.

claims.claim: Timing shift was the weakest known post-freeze failure mode at 98.571% recall; leakage spike and voltage drift each reached 98.75%, and resistance bridge reached 100%.
claims.allowed_wording: Weakest known-mode recall was 98.571% for timing shift.

claims.claim: Serving verifies the classifier, VAE, dataset manifest, evaluation artifact, and bundle identity before inference.
claims.allowed_wording: Hash-bound frozen classifier/VAE policy with fail-closed schema and lot-context validation.

claims.claim: The frozen policy is available through a bounded CLI, authenticated FastAPI endpoint, Streamlit evidence dashboard, and non-root container definition.
claims.allowed_wording: Delivered a bounded CLI, authenticated API, evidence dashboard, and non-root container reference.

claims.claim: A bounded local Windows CPU API measurement completed 100 authenticated one-chip requests at concurrency five without errors.
claims.allowed_wording: Local Windows CPU API measurement: 100/100 authenticated requests, 10.22 requests/s, and 470.50/565.37/721.73 ms p50/p95/p99 at concurrency five; not a production SLO.

unsupported_claims: Zero escapees are guaranteed by OR logic.
The policy has demonstrated production test-time or cost savings.
Synthetic failure modes establish coverage of physical semiconductor defects.
The local latency, container, or throughput behavior is a production service-level objective.
The frozen policy is approved for unsupervised production deployment.
